selection.summary: Issue #1971: `gh repo view .` fails because base viewRun (view.go@base:75-100) resolves any RepoArg without '/' as currentUser/RepoArg via ghrepo.FromFullName, with no handling for the local-directory shorthand '.'. The readme is fetched by RepositoryReadme (http.go@base:1-53) against the resolved ghrepo. Fix: when RepoArg is '.', fall back to opts.BaseRepo() so the current repository's README is displayed; h6/h8 confirm the rest of viewRun renders the readme normally once toView is resolved.
